# Slatebox documentation

Official guides for using the app, building with SlateboxJS, calling the HTTP API, and self-hosting.

The same files are available from the [published documentation repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/llms.txt). To fetch a guide there, append its case-sensitive path to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/.

## Using Slatebox

- [Slatebox user guide](https://docs.slatebox.com/Using-Slatebox/readme.md)
